content.text: The letter's performance paragraph reports the account's own returns (1.2% net, 1.4% gross, 2.8% YTD, 9.4% since inception) but omits any reference to the comparison index. There is no mention anywhere of the 50% global equity / 50% US intermediate aggregate bond blend or the 1.7% figure, so the client has no basis for comparing the 1.2% net return against its benchmark — a notable omission given the account underperformed.
